description: Who is told. The Clerk (r2) holds a `ref` to the Inventory (r1) but its machine has no `on inventory.ended`, so it is not sent the end and writes nothing for it. The Picker (r3) hears it, but is Idle, whose states have no `on inventory.ended`, when it takes it: it writes `dropped`. Told once, it is not told again when it goes on to Watching.
